name: map-drive
tagline: "Map network drive" for Linux: one small script, no Samba suite.
description: Connects a Windows or NAS share by its UNC path to a drive letter, reconnects it after every restart with a systemd automount, and adds it to the KDE and GTK file manager sidebars. Needs only cifs-utils.
features: Map \\server\share to a drive letter in one command
Reconnects on demand after every boot, never blocks startup
Password in a root-only file, never on a command line
Sidebar entry in Dolphin, KDE dialogs and GTK file managers
Rolls back everything if the first connection fails
